source: 亮星介绍为手写整理：距离以 Hipparcos（2007 新归算）/Gaia 视差及常见文献为准，光谱型与半径、质量、光度取自公开文献综述的常用值（多星系统取主星），不确定项置 null。

32349.zh: 天狼星是全夜空最亮的恒星（−1.46 等），距离仅 8.6 光年，是离我们最近的恒星之一。它是一颗白色主序星，身边绕着一颗白矮星伴星天狼 B，约 50 年绕转一周。古埃及人以天狼星在黎明前首次升起来预告尼罗河泛滥。
32349.en: Sirius is the brightest star in the night sky (mag −1.46) and, at 8.6 light-years, one of our nearest neighbours. It is a white main-sequence star orbited every ~50 years by a white dwarf companion, Sirius B. Ancient Egyptians used its first dawn rising to herald the Nile flood.

30438.zh: 老人星是全天第二亮的恒星，一颗距离约 310 光年的白色亮巨星，光度约为太阳的一万倍。它位于南天船底座，在中国只有南方地区能看到它贴近地平线，古人称之为“南极老人星”“寿星”，视为长寿吉兆。许多航天器曾用它作为姿态导航的参考星。
30438.en: Canopus is the second-brightest star in the sky, a white bright giant about 310 light-years away and roughly 10,000 times as luminous as the Sun. From China it only skims the southern horizon, and was revered as the 'Old Man of the South Pole', the star of longevity. Many spacecraft have used it as an attitude reference star.

69673.zh: 大角是北天球最亮的恒星，全天排名第四，是一颗距离 37 光年的橙色巨星，直径约为太阳的 25 倍。中国古人把它看作东方苍龙的龙角，“大角”即由此得名。它的自行很快，属于银河系较古老的恒星族群；1933 年芝加哥世博会曾用它的星光触发开幕灯光。
69673.en: Arcturus is the brightest star of the northern celestial hemisphere and fourth overall, an orange giant 37 light-years away with about 25 times the Sun's radius. In China it marked the horn of the Azure Dragon, hence the name 'Great Horn'. It has a large proper motion, belonging to an older stellar population; its light was used to switch on the 1933 Chicago World's Fair.

71683.zh: 南门二（半人马座 α）是离太阳最近的恒星系统，距离约 4.37 光年。肉眼看到的是两颗类太阳恒星 A、B 合在一起的光，约 80 年互绕一周；第三颗成员比邻星是一颗暗红矮星，拥有已确认的系外行星。中国星官“南门”意为天上的南方城门。
71683.en: Alpha Centauri (Rigil Kentaurus) is the nearest star system to the Sun, about 4.37 light-years away. To the eye it is the combined light of two Sun-like stars, A and B, orbiting each other every ~80 years; the third member, Proxima Centauri, is a faint red dwarf with a confirmed exoplanet. Its Chinese name means the Southern Gate.

91262.zh: 织女一是夏季大三角之一，距离 25 光年的白色主序星，长期被当作星等和颜色测光的零点标准。它自转极快，赤道明显鼓起；1983 年红外天文卫星在它周围发现尘埃盘，这是首次在其他恒星周围发现此类盘。由于岁差，约一万两千年后它会成为北极星。
91262.en: Vega, a corner of the Summer Triangle, is a white main-sequence star 25 light-years away, long used as the zero point of the magnitude and colour scales. It spins so fast that its equator bulges noticeably. In 1983 IRAS found a dusty disk around it, the first such disk detected around another star. Precession will make it the pole star in about 12,000 years.

24608.zh: 五车二是全天第六亮星，距离约 43 光年。它其实是两颗黄色巨星组成的密近双星，约 104 天互绕一周，望远镜也难以分开；远处还有一对红矮星，构成四合星系统。它是御夫座主星，冬季夜空高悬头顶，中国星官“五车”代表五辆天车。
24608.en: Capella, the sixth-brightest star, lies about 43 light-years away. It is actually a close pair of yellow giants orbiting every ~104 days, plus a distant pair of red dwarfs, making a quadruple system. The leading star of Auriga, it rides high on winter nights; the Chinese asterism Wuche means the Five Chariots.

24436.zh: 参宿七是猎户座最亮的星、全天第七亮，一颗距离约 860 光年的蓝超巨星，光度达太阳的十万倍以上。它位于猎户的左脚（从地面看在右下角），与红色的参宿四形成鲜明色差。它质量约 20 倍太阳，未来很可能以超新星结束一生。
24436.en: Rigel, the brightest star in Orion and seventh in the sky, is a blue supergiant about 860 light-years away, more than 100,000 times as luminous as the Sun. It marks Orion's foot and contrasts sharply with red Betelgeuse. At roughly 20 solar masses it will probably end as a supernova.

37279.zh: 南河三是小犬座主星，距离仅 11.5 光年，是离我们最近的亮星之一。它是一颗稍亮于主序的黄白色恒星，身边有一颗白矮星伴星南河三 B。英文名意为“在狗之前”，因为它总比天狼星早一步升起；它与天狼、参宿四组成冬季大三角。
37279.en: Procyon, the leading star of Canis Minor, is only 11.5 light-years away. It is a yellow-white star just leaving the main sequence, with a white dwarf companion, Procyon B. Its name means 'before the dog' because it rises just ahead of Sirius; with Sirius and Betelgeuse it forms the Winter Triangle.

7588.zh: 水委一是波江座主星，全天第九亮，距离约 140 光年。它是已知最扁的恒星之一：自转极快，赤道半径比极半径大约五成，周围还有一圈被甩出的气体盘，属于 Be 星。英文名源自阿拉伯语“河的尽头”，标志着波江座长河的南端。
7588.en: Achernar, the brightest star of Eridanus and ninth in the sky, lies about 140 light-years away. It is one of the most flattened stars known: it spins so fast that its equatorial radius is about 50% larger than its polar radius, and it sheds a gas disk, making it a Be star. Its Arabic name means 'end of the river'.

27989.zh: 参宿四是猎户座的红肩膀，一颗约 550 光年外的红超巨星，若放在太阳位置，其表面将越过火星轨道。它是半规则变星，2019–2020 年曾发生“大暗化”，后被证实主要是喷出的尘埃遮挡所致。它是最著名的超新星候选者，但爆发可能还要等上万年。
27989.en: Betelgeuse, Orion's red shoulder, is a red supergiant about 550 light-years away; placed at the Sun, its surface would reach beyond the orbit of Mars. It is a semi-regular variable, and its 'Great Dimming' of 2019–2020 was traced mainly to ejected dust. It is the most famous supernova candidate, though the explosion may be tens of thousands of years away.

68702.zh: 马腹一是半人马座 β，全天第十一亮，距离约 390 光年。它是由两颗几乎相同的蓝巨星组成的密近双星，主星还是 β 仙王型脉动变星，外加一颗远伴星。它与南门二一起被称为“南十字指极星”，两星连线指向南十字座。
68702.en: Hadar (Beta Centauri), eleventh-brightest, is about 390 light-years away. It is a close pair of nearly identical blue giants, one of which pulsates as a Beta Cephei variable, plus a more distant companion. With Alpha Centauri it forms the 'Pointers' that lead the eye to the Southern Cross.

97649.zh: 河鼓二即牛郎星，距离 16.7 光年，是夏季大三角中最近的一颗。它自转极快，赤道转速超过每秒 280 公里，不到 9 小时转一圈，使星体明显扁平；它也是除太阳外第一颗被干涉仪直接拍到表面图像的主序星。隔银河与织女星相望，是牛郎织女传说的主角。
97649.en: Altair, 16.7 light-years away, is the nearest star of the Summer Triangle. It rotates extremely fast, over 280 km/s at the equator and once in under 9 hours, flattening it noticeably; it was the first main-sequence star besides the Sun to have its surface imaged by interferometry. In Chinese legend it is the Cowherd, facing Vega across the Milky Way.

60718.zh: 十字架二是南十字座最亮的星，位于十字的底端，距离约 320 光年。小望远镜可把它分成两颗蓝白色热星，其中较亮者本身又是光谱双星。南十字的长轴大致指向南天极，是南半球传统的寻南方法，这颗星也出现在澳大利亚、新西兰、巴西等国国旗上。
60718.en: Acrux, the brightest star of the Southern Cross, marks its foot about 320 light-years away. A small telescope splits it into two hot blue-white stars, the brighter itself a spectroscopic binary. The Cross's long axis points roughly to the south celestial pole, a classic southern navigation aid, and it appears on the flags of Australia, New Zealand and Brazil.

21421.zh: 毕宿五是金牛的红色“牛眼”，一颗距离约 65 光年的橙巨星，半径约为太阳的 45 倍。它看起来位于毕星团中，实际上距离只有星团的一半左右，只是恰好在同一视线方向。它靠近黄道，常被月球掩食；先驱者 10 号大致朝它的方向飞去。
21421.en: Aldebaran, the red 'eye of the Bull', is an orange giant about 65 light-years away with some 45 times the Sun's radius. It appears to sit in the Hyades cluster but is only about half as far, merely in the same line of sight. Lying near the ecliptic, it is often occulted by the Moon; Pioneer 10 is heading roughly in its direction.

65474.zh: 角宿一是室女座主星，距离约 250 光年，是一对仅 4 天互绕一周的蓝色热星，彼此潮汐拉扯成椭球形，亮度随之轻微起伏。古希腊天文学家喜帕恰斯正是比较它的位置变化而发现了岁差。在中国它是二十八宿之首“角宿”的第一星，代表苍龙之角。
65474.en: Spica, the leading star of Virgo, lies about 250 light-years away. It is a pair of hot blue stars orbiting every 4 days, tidally stretched into ellipsoids so its light varies slightly. Hipparchus discovered precession by comparing its positions. In China it is the first star of Jiao, the first of the 28 lunar mansions, the horn of the Azure Dragon.

80763.zh: 心宿二是天蝎的红色心脏，一颗约 550 光年外的红超巨星，半径约为太阳的 680 倍。英文名意为“火星的对手”，因其颜色与火星相似且常在其附近出现；中国古称“大火”，《诗经》“七月流火”说的正是它西沉。它有一颗蓝色热伴星，未来将以超新星终结。
80763.en: Antares, the red heart of Scorpius, is a red supergiant about 550 light-years away with roughly 680 times the Sun's radius. Its name means 'rival of Mars' for its similar colour. Ancient China called it Dahuo, the Great Fire, whose westward sinking is sung in the Book of Songs. It has a hot blue companion and will end as a supernova.

37826.zh: 北河三是双子座最亮的星（虽然编号为 β），距离 34 光年，是离太阳最近的巨星之一。它是一颗橙巨星，2006 年确认有一颗质量至少为木星 2 倍多的行星绕它运行。它与北河二并列为双子兄弟的头部，中国星官“北河”意为北方的河界。
37826.en: Pollux is the brightest star in Gemini despite its Beta label, and at 34 light-years one of the nearest giant stars. This orange giant hosts a planet of at least about twice Jupiter's mass, confirmed in 2006. With Castor it marks the heads of the Twins; the Chinese name Beihe means the Northern River.

113368.zh: 北落师门是南鱼座主星，距离 25 光年，秋季南天唯一的亮星，因而格外醒目。它被一圈清晰的尘埃环包围，哈勃望远镜和韦布望远镜都拍到过；早年宣称在环中直接拍到的行星后来被认为可能只是尘埃云。中国星名意为羽林军营的北门。
113368.en: Fomalhaut, the leading star of Piscis Austrinus 25 light-years away, stands alone in the autumn southern sky. It is surrounded by a sharp dust ring imaged by Hubble and Webb; a planet once claimed to be imaged in the ring is now thought likely to be a dust cloud. Its Chinese name means the North Gate of the army camp.

62434.zh: 十字架三是南十字座第二亮星，位于十字的左臂，距离约 280 光年。它是一颗蓝巨星，也是 β 仙王型脉动变星，亮度有细微的周期变化，并有一颗光谱伴星。它与十字架二一起出现在多国国旗的南十字图案中。
62434.en: Mimosa, the second-brightest star of the Southern Cross, marks one arm about 280 light-years away. It is a blue giant and a Beta Cephei pulsating variable with small periodic brightness changes, and has a spectroscopic companion. With Acrux it appears in the Southern Cross on several national flags.

102098.zh: 天津四是天鹅座的尾巴、夏季大三角中最远的一颗，距离估计约 2600 光年，光度可能达太阳的近二十万倍，是肉眼可见的最明亮恒星之一。它是天鹅 α 型变星的原型。中国星官“天津”意为银河上的渡口，正横跨银河，也被联想为鹊桥。
102098.en: Deneb, the tail of the Swan and the most distant corner of the Summer Triangle, is estimated at about 2,600 light-years and perhaps nearly 200,000 times the Sun's luminosity, one of the most luminous naked-eye stars. It is the prototype of the Alpha Cygni variables. Its Chinese asterism Tianjin, the Heavenly Ford, spans the Milky Way.

49669.zh: 轩辕十四是狮子座的心脏，距离 79 光年。它自转极快，约 16 小时转一圈，已接近被离心力撕裂的极限，星体明显扁平；它还有暗弱的伴星。它几乎正位于黄道上，常被月球掩食，偶尔也被行星掩食。中国星官“轩辕”象征黄帝之神或黄龙。
49669.en: Regulus, the heart of the Lion, is 79 light-years away. It spins once in about 16 hours, close to breakup speed, so it is visibly flattened, and it has faint companions. Lying almost exactly on the ecliptic, it is often occulted by the Moon and occasionally by planets. The Chinese asterism Xuanyuan represents the Yellow Emperor's dragon.

33579.zh: 弧矢七是大犬座第二亮星，一颗距离约 430 光年的蓝色亮巨星，是全天最强的极紫外辐射源。约 470 万年前它距离我们只有 34 光年，当时亮度约 −4 等，是那时夜空中最亮的恒星。中国星官“弧矢”是一张弓箭，箭头正对着天狼。
33579.en: Adhara, the second-brightest star of Canis Major, is a blue bright giant about 430 light-years away and the strongest extreme-ultraviolet source in the sky. About 4.7 million years ago it was only 34 light-years away at about mag −4, the brightest star in the sky then. The Chinese asterism Hushi is a bow and arrow aimed at Sirius.

36850.zh: 北河二是双子座 α，距离约 51 光年。它是著名的六合星：望远镜下可见的两颗白色星 A、B 各自又是光谱双星，再加上一对红矮星组成的食双星 Castor C（双子座 YY）。它与北河三并称双子兄弟，但两者并无物理关联。
36850.en: Castor (Alpha Geminorum), about 51 light-years away, is a famous sextuple system: the two white stars A and B seen in a telescope are each spectroscopic binaries, joined by a pair of eclipsing red dwarfs, Castor C (YY Geminorum). It pairs with Pollux as the Twins, though the two are not physically related.

61084.zh: 十字架一是南十字座顶端的红色星，距离约 89 光年，是离太阳最近的 M 型红巨星。它与底端的十字架二连成十字长轴，沿此方向延长约 4.5 倍长度就接近南天极，是南半球寻找正南的常用方法。
61084.en: Gacrux, the red star at the top of the Southern Cross, lies about 89 light-years away and is the nearest M-type red giant to the Sun. With Acrux at the foot it defines the Cross's long axis; extending that line about 4.5 times brings you near the south celestial pole, a common way to find due south.

85927.zh: 尾宿八是天蝎座的“毒针”，距离约 570 光年，是全天第二十五亮星。它是一个三合星系统，主星是 β 仙王型脉动变星。英文名源自阿拉伯语，意为“翘起的尾巴”；中国二十八宿中它属于尾宿，即苍龙之尾。
85927.en: Shaula, the 'stinger' of Scorpius about 570 light-years away, is the 25th-brightest star. It is a triple system whose primary is a Beta Cephei pulsating variable. Its Arabic name means 'the raised tail'; in China it belongs to Wei, the Tail mansion of the Azure Dragon.

25336.zh: 参宿五是猎户的右肩（从地面看在左上），距离约 250 光年，是一颗炽热的蓝白色星。它比猎户座其他亮星近得多，并不属于猎户座 OB 星协。拉丁名意为“女战士”；在中国它属于参宿，参宿是二十八宿中的西方白虎之一。
25336.en: Bellatrix marks Orion's other shoulder, about 250 light-years away, a hot blue-white star. It is much closer than Orion's other bright stars and not part of the Orion OB association. Its Latin name means 'female warrior'; in China it belongs to Shen, one of the White Tiger mansions.

25428.zh: 五车五是金牛座 β，位于金牛的北角尖端，距离约 134 光年。历史上它曾被御夫座和金牛座共用，因而也有御夫座 γ 之称。它是一颗汞锰特殊星，光谱中锰等元素异常丰富。
25428.en: Elnath (Beta Tauri) marks the tip of the Bull's northern horn, about 134 light-years away. It was historically shared with Auriga, also known as Gamma Aurigae. It is a mercury-manganese chemically peculiar star with unusual abundances of elements like manganese.

45238.zh: 南船五是船底座 β，距离约 113 光年，是南天一颗明亮的白色巨星。英文名是拉丁和阿拉伯语的混合，意为“平静的水域”。它位于南天极附近，在中国大部分地区看不到。
45238.en: Miaplacidus (Beta Carinae), about 113 light-years away, is a bright white giant of the far south. Its name mixes Arabic and Latin, roughly 'placid waters'. Lying near the south celestial pole, it is invisible from most of China.

26311.zh: 参宿二是猎户腰带三星的中间一颗，一颗蓝超巨星，距离不确定，常引用约 2000 光年，光度达太阳的数十万倍。它被自身吹出的星风和反射星云 NGC 1990 包围。参宿腰带三星在中国民间称“福禄寿三星”。
26311.en: Alnilam, the middle star of Orion's Belt, is a blue supergiant whose distance is uncertain, often quoted near 2,000 light-years, with hundreds of thousands of times the Sun's luminosity. It is wrapped in its own stellar wind and the reflection nebula NGC 1990. In Chinese folklore the three Belt stars are the gods of fortune, prosperity and longevity.

109268.zh: 鹤一是天鹤座主星，距离约 101 光年，是一颗快速自转的蓝白色星。英文名源自阿拉伯语，意为“（鱼尾上）明亮的那颗”。它在中国南方冬季的南方低空可见。
109268.en: Alnair, the leading star of Grus, is a fast-rotating blue-white star about 101 light-years away. Its Arabic name means 'the bright one' (of the fish's tail). It can be seen low in the south from southern China.

26727.zh: 参宿一是猎户腰带最东边的一颗，是夜空中最亮的 O 型星之一，系统含三颗成员，距离约 1260 光年。著名的马头星云和火焰星云就在它附近，火焰星云主要由它的紫外辐射照亮。
26727.en: Alnitak, the easternmost star of Orion's Belt, is one of the brightest O-type stars in the night sky, a triple system about 1,260 light-years away. The famous Horsehead and Flame nebulae lie next to it, the Flame being lit mainly by its ultraviolet light.

39953.zh: 天社一是船帆座 γ2，是全天最亮的沃尔夫-拉叶星，与一颗 O 型巨星组成双星，距离约 1100 光年。英文名 Regor 是阿波罗 1 号宇航员格里森开的玩笑：把同伴 Roger Chaffee 的名字倒过来写。沃尔夫-拉叶星已剥去外层，正走向超新星。
39953.en: Gamma² Velorum is the brightest Wolf-Rayet star in the sky, paired with an O-type giant about 1,100 light-years away. The name Regor was a prank by Apollo 1 astronaut Gus Grissom, spelling his crewmate Roger Chaffee's name backwards. Wolf-Rayet stars have shed their outer layers and are heading for supernova.

62956.zh: 玉衡是北斗七星的第五星，也是大熊座最亮的星，距离约 83 光年。它是一颗化学特殊星，表面元素分布不均，随自转亮度有微小变化。它与北斗中多数星同属大熊座移动星群，一起在空间中运动。
62956.en: Alioth, the fifth star of the Big Dipper, is the brightest in Ursa Major, about 83 light-years away. It is a chemically peculiar star with patchy surface abundances that cause slight brightness changes as it rotates. Like most Dipper stars it belongs to the Ursa Major Moving Group.

15863.zh: 天船三是英仙座主星，一颗距离约 510 光年的黄白色超巨星。它周围散布着一群蓝白色年轻恒星，即英仙 α 星团（Melotte 20），双筒望远镜中非常漂亮。中国星官“天船”意为天上的船。
15863.en: Mirfak, the leading star of Perseus, is a yellow-white supergiant about 510 light-years away. It sits in a scattering of young blue-white stars, the Alpha Persei Cluster (Melotte 20), a beautiful binocular sight. The Chinese asterism Tianchuan means the Heavenly Boat.

90185.zh: 箕宿三是人马座最亮的星，位于“茶壶”星群壶底，距离约 143 光年。英文名意为“弓的南部”；中国二十八宿中它属于箕宿，即苍龙尾后的簸箕。
90185.en: Kaus Australis is the brightest star in Sagittarius, at the base of the 'Teapot' about 143 light-years away. Its name means 'southern part of the bow'; in China it belongs to Ji, the Winnowing Basket mansion.

54061.zh: 天枢是北斗七星的第一星，距离约 123 光年，是一颗橙巨星，有一颗较近的伴星。它和天璇被称为“指极星”：从天璇向天枢延长约五倍距离即可找到北极星。与北斗大多数星不同，它不属于大熊座移动星群。
54061.en: Dubhe, the first star of the Big Dipper, is an orange giant about 123 light-years away with a close companion. With Merak it forms the 'Pointers': extend the line from Merak through Dubhe about five times to reach Polaris. Unlike most Dipper stars it is not part of the Ursa Major Moving Group.

34444.zh: 弧矢一是大犬座 δ，一颗距离约 1600 光年的黄白色超巨星，光度达太阳的数万倍。它已经耗尽核心氢，正在膨胀，被认为未来可能以超新星终结。在中国星官中它是弧矢之弓的一部分。
34444.en: Wezen (Delta Canis Majoris) is a yellow-white supergiant about 1,600 light-years away, tens of thousands of times as luminous as the Sun. Having exhausted core hydrogen it is expanding and may eventually become a supernova. In Chinese astronomy it forms part of the bow of Hushi.

67301.zh: 摇光是北斗七星斗柄末端的一颗，距离约 104 光年，是一颗炽热的蓝白色主序星。它和天枢一样不属于大熊座移动星群，因此数万年后北斗的形状会逐渐改变。斗柄指向在中国古代用来判断季节。
67301.en: Alkaid, at the end of the Big Dipper's handle, is a hot blue-white main-sequence star about 104 light-years away. Like Dubhe it is not part of the Ursa Major Moving Group, so the Dipper's shape will change over tens of thousands of years. In ancient China the handle's direction marked the seasons.

41037.zh: 海石一是船底座 ε，距离约 600 光年，由一颗橙巨星和一颗蓝色热星组成双星。它和海石二、天社三、天社五组成“假十字”，常被误认为南十字。英文名 Avior 是 1930 年代英国航海天文历为航空导航新取的名字。
41037.en: Avior (Epsilon Carinae), about 600 light-years away, pairs an orange giant with a hot blue star. With Aspidiske, Delta and Kappa Velorum it forms the 'False Cross', often mistaken for the Southern Cross. The name Avior was coined in the 1930s by the British Nautical Almanac Office for air navigation.

86228.zh: 尾宿五是天蝎座 θ，位于蝎尾弯钩处，距离约 300 光年，是一颗黄白色亮巨星。在中国二十八宿中它属于尾宿。它的赤纬约 −43°，在中国北方很难看到。
86228.en: Sargas (Theta Scorpii) lies in the curl of the Scorpion's tail about 300 light-years away, a yellow-white bright giant. In China it belongs to the Wei (Tail) mansion. At declination about −43° it is hard to see from northern China.

28360.zh: 五车三是御夫座 β，距离约 81 光年，是一对几乎一样的白色星组成的食双星，每 3.96 天互绕一周，期间亮度会因互相遮挡而轻微下降。英文名意为“御者的肩膀”。
28360.en: Menkalinan (Beta Aurigae), about 81 light-years away, is a pair of nearly identical white stars that eclipse each other every 3.96 days, causing slight dips in brightness. Its name means 'shoulder of the charioteer'.

82273.zh: 三角形三是南三角座主星，一颗距离约 390 光年的橙色巨星，颜色在南天亮星中十分醒目。它位于南天极附近，在中国大部分地区看不到；巴西国旗上也有这颗星。
82273.en: Atria, the leading star of Triangulum Australe, is an orange giant about 390 light-years away whose colour stands out among southern stars. Close to the south celestial pole, it is invisible from most of China; it also appears on the flag of Brazil.

31681.zh: 井宿三是双子座 γ，位于双子的脚边，距离约 109 光年，是一颗白色亚巨星，有一颗光谱伴星。它靠近黄道，偶尔会被月球或行星掩食。在中国它属于二十八宿的井宿。
31681.en: Alhena (Gamma Geminorum), at the Twins' feet about 109 light-years away, is a white subgiant with a spectroscopic companion. Lying near the ecliptic, it is occasionally occulted by the Moon or planets. In China it belongs to the Jing (Well) mansion.

42913.zh: 天社三是船帆座 δ，距离约 80 光年，是一个多星系统。它的主星是食双星，这一点直到 2000 年前后才由伽利略号木星探测器的星敏感器偶然发现。它是“假十字”的一角；英文名 Alsephina 于 2017 年由国际天文学联合会批准。
42913.en: Delta Velorum, about 80 light-years away, is a multiple system whose main pair is an eclipsing binary, found by chance around 2000 by the star tracker of the Galileo spacecraft. It is a corner of the 'False Cross'; the IAU approved the name Alsephina in 2017.

100751.zh: 孔雀十一是孔雀座主星，距离约 180 光年，是一颗蓝白色光谱双星。英文名 Peacock 是 1930 年代英国航海天文历为空中导航新取的名字，因为它原本没有通用的传统名称。
100751.en: Peacock, the leading star of Pavo about 180 light-years away, is a blue-white spectroscopic binary. The name was coined in the 1930s by the British Nautical Almanac Office for air navigation, as the star had no common traditional name.

11767.zh: 勾陈一就是北极星，距北天极不到 1°，几乎整夜不动，千百年来是北半球导航的基准，其高度角约等于观测地纬度。它是离我们最近的造父变星，约 4 天一个脉动周期，并组成三合星系统。由于岁差，它约在 2100 年最接近北天极。
11767.en: Polaris, the North Star, lies less than 1° from the north celestial pole and barely moves all night; its altitude roughly equals the observer's latitude, making it a navigation reference for centuries. It is the nearest Cepheid variable, pulsating with a period of about 4 days, in a triple system. Precession brings it closest to the pole around 2100.

30324.zh: 军市一是大犬座 β，距离约 490 光年，是一颗蓝色巨星，也是 β 仙王型脉动变星中的典型代表。英文名意为“宣告者”，因为它总在天狼星之前升起，仿佛为天狼开道。
30324.en: Mirzam (Beta Canis Majoris), about 490 light-years away, is a blue giant and a classic Beta Cephei pulsating variable. Its name means 'the herald', since it rises just before Sirius.

46390.zh: 星宿一是长蛇座最亮的星，距离约 177 光年，一颗橙巨星。英文名意为“孤独者”，因为它周围天区没有其他亮星。它在中国是二十八宿星宿（南方朱雀的颈部）的主星。
46390.en: Alphard, the brightest star in Hydra, is an orange giant about 177 light-years away. Its name means 'the solitary one', as no other bright star lies nearby. In China it leads Xing, the Star mansion at the neck of the Vermilion Bird.

9884.zh: 娄宿三是白羊座主星，距离约 66 光年，一颗橙巨星，2011 年报告有一颗类木行星绕其运行。约两千多年前春分点位于白羊座，因此它在古代历法中地位重要。在中国它属于二十八宿的娄宿。
9884.en: Hamal, the leading star of Aries, is an orange giant about 66 light-years away, reported in 2011 to host a Jupiter-like planet. Over two thousand years ago the vernal equinox lay in Aries, giving the star importance in ancient calendars. In China it belongs to the Lou mansion.

50583.zh: 轩辕十二是狮子座 γ，距离约 130 光年，是一对橙色和黄色巨星组成的漂亮目视双星，小望远镜即可分开，互绕周期约 500 年。它属于狮子座“镰刀”星群的一部分。
50583.en: Algieba (Gamma Leonis), about 130 light-years away, is a beautiful double of orange and yellow giants that a small telescope can split, orbiting every ~500 years. It is part of the 'Sickle' asterism of Leo.

3419.zh: 土司空是鲸鱼座最亮的星（编号为 β），距离约 96 光年，是一颗橙巨星，曾观测到较强的 X 射线耀发。它位于秋季南天相对空旷的区域，中国星名意为掌管土木的官员。
3419.en: Diphda is the brightest star in Cetus despite its Beta label, an orange giant about 96 light-years away that has shown strong X-ray flares. It sits in a sparse part of the autumn southern sky; its Chinese name refers to an official in charge of earthworks.

92855.zh: 斗宿四是人马座 σ，距离约 228 光年，是一颗蓝白色主序星。它是中国“南斗六星”之一，民间有“南斗注生，北斗注死”的说法。英文名 Nunki 源自古巴比伦名称。
92855.en: Nunki (Sigma Sagittarii), about 228 light-years away, is a blue-white main-sequence star. It is one of the Chinese 'Southern Dipper' six stars, linked in folklore with birth as the Northern Dipper is with death. The name Nunki comes from Babylonian.

68933.zh: 库楼三是半人马座 θ，距离约 59 光年，是一颗橙巨星，也是半人马座离我们较近的亮星之一。中国星官“库楼”意为兵车仓库。
68933.en: Menkent (Theta Centauri), about 59 light-years away, is an orange giant and one of the closer bright stars in Centaurus. The Chinese asterism Kulou means the arsenal for war chariots.

677.zh: 壁宿二是仙女座主星，距离约 97 光年，同时是“飞马大四边形”的一角，历史上也被称为飞马座 δ。它是一颗汞锰特殊星，并与伴星组成光谱双星。中国二十八宿中它属于壁宿。
677.en: Alpheratz, the leading star of Andromeda about 97 light-years away, is also a corner of the Great Square of Pegasus and was once called Delta Pegasi. It is a mercury-manganese peculiar star in a spectroscopic binary. In China it belongs to the Bi (Wall) mansion.

5447.zh: 奎宿九是仙女座 β，一颗距离约 200 光年的红巨星。它是寻找仙女座星系的路标：从它向北经过仙女 μ 即可找到 M31。在它旁边有一个暗弱的星系 NGC 404，因常被其光芒淹没而被称为“奎宿九的幽灵”。
5447.en: Mirach (Beta Andromedae) is a red giant about 200 light-years away. It is the classic signpost to the Andromeda Galaxy: hop north via Mu Andromedae to find M31. Beside it lies the faint galaxy NGC 404, nicknamed 'Mirach's Ghost' because it is lost in the star's glare.

27366.zh: 参宿六是猎户的右膝（从地面看在左下角），距离约 650 光年，是一颗蓝超巨星，与参宿七距离相近、光度也很高，但大部分辐射在紫外波段，所以目视亮度稍逊。它最终也可能以超新星结束。
27366.en: Saiph marks Orion's other knee, about 650 light-years away. This blue supergiant is at a similar distance to Rigel and also highly luminous, but emits much of its light in the ultraviolet, so it appears fainter. It may also end as a supernova.

72607.zh: 北极二是小熊座 β，距离约 131 光年的橙巨星。约公元前 1500 年至公元 500 年间，它与太子（小熊 γ）是离北天极最近的亮星，被称为“极之守卫”。中国古代的“北极”星官即以它为“帝星”，象征天帝。
72607.en: Kochab (Beta Ursae Minoris) is an orange giant about 131 light-years away. From about 1500 BC to AD 500 it and Pherkad were the bright stars closest to the north pole, the 'Guardians of the Pole'. In ancient China it was the Emperor star of the Beiji (North Pole) asterism.

112122.zh: 鹤二是天鹤座 β，一颗距离约 177 光年的红巨星，亮度有半规则变化。英文名 Tiaki 来自波利尼西亚土阿莫土语，2017 年由国际天文学联合会批准。它与鹤一的红白色差在双筒中很明显。
112122.en: Beta Gruis is a red giant about 177 light-years away with semi-regular brightness variations. Its name Tiaki comes from the Tuamotuan (Polynesian) language and was approved by the IAU in 2017. Its red colour contrasts nicely with white Alnair.

86032.zh: 侯是蛇夫座主星，距离约 49 光年，位于蛇夫的头部。它是一颗快速自转的白色星，有一颗伴星，通过追踪双星轨道测得了它的质量。中国星名“侯”是天市垣中的一颗星，意为观测天象的官员。
86032.en: Rasalhague, the leading star of Ophiuchus, marks the Serpent-bearer's head about 49 light-years away. It is a fast-rotating white star with a companion whose orbit has been used to measure its mass. Its Chinese name Hou refers to an official who watches the sky, in the Heavenly Market enclosure.

14576.zh: 大陵五是最著名的食双星：每 2.87 天，较暗的伴星挡住明亮主星，亮度在约 10 小时内从 2.1 等降到 3.4 等再恢复，1783 年古德里克测定了它的周期。英文名意为“魔头”，代表美杜莎的头颅。它还揭示了“大陵五佯谬”：质量较小的星反而演化更快，原因是双星间的物质转移。
14576.en: Algol is the most famous eclipsing binary: every 2.87 days a dimmer companion blocks the bright primary, dropping it from mag 2.1 to 3.4 over about 10 hours; John Goodricke measured the period in 1783. Its name means 'the Demon's Head', Medusa's head. It also posed the 'Algol paradox', the less massive star being more evolved, explained by mass transfer.

9640.zh: 天大将军一是仙女座 γ，距离约 350 光年，是天文爱好者最喜爱的双星之一：小望远镜下呈现金黄色主星和蓝色伴星的强烈色差。伴星本身又是三合星，整个系统共有四颗成员。
9640.en: Almach (Gamma Andromedae), about 350 light-years away, is a favourite double: a small telescope shows a golden primary and a blue companion in striking contrast. The companion is itself triple, giving four stars in all.

57632.zh: 五帝座一是狮子的尾巴，距离约 36 光年，是一颗白色主序星，也是 δ 盾牌型变星，周围有尘埃盘。它与大角、角宿一组成春季大三角。中国星官“五帝座”象征五方天帝。
57632.en: Denebola, the Lion's tail, is a white main-sequence star about 36 light-years away, a Delta Scuti variable with a dusty debris disk. With Arcturus and Spica it forms the Spring Triangle. The Chinese asterism Wudizuo represents the thrones of the Five Emperors.

4427.zh: 策是仙后座 γ，“W”形的中心，距离约 550 光年。它是 Be 星的原型：1866 年塞奇首次在它的光谱中看到发射线，亮度曾在 1.6–3 等间不规则变化。英文名 Navi 是宇航员格里森把自己中间名 Ivan 倒写而来。中国星名“策”是王良驾车的马鞭。
4427.en: Gamma Cassiopeiae, the centre of the 'W' about 550 light-years away, is the prototype Be star: in 1866 Secchi first saw emission lines in its spectrum, and it has varied irregularly between about mag 1.6 and 3. The name Navi is astronaut Gus Grissom's middle name Ivan reversed. Its Chinese name Ce is the whip of the charioteer Wangliang.

61932.zh: 库楼七是半人马座 γ，距离约 130 光年，由两颗几乎等亮的白色星组成，互绕周期约 85 年，需要较大望远镜才能分开。中国星官“库楼”代表兵车仓库。
61932.en: Muhlifain (Gamma Centauri), about 130 light-years away, consists of two nearly equal white stars orbiting every ~85 years, requiring a sizeable telescope to split. The Chinese asterism Kulou is the chariot arsenal.

39429.zh: 弧矢增二十二是船尾座 ζ，是肉眼可见最炽热、最明亮的恒星之一，表面温度约 4 万度。它是一颗高速飞离诞生地的“逃逸星”，且自转很快。英文名 Naos 意为“船”。
39429.en: Naos (Zeta Puppis) is one of the hottest and most luminous naked-eye stars, with a surface temperature around 40,000 K. It is a runaway star speeding away from its birthplace and rotates rapidly. Its name means 'ship'.

45556.zh: 海石二是船底座 ι，一颗距离约 770 光年的白色超巨星，是“假十字”的一角。英文名 Aspidiske 意为“小盾牌”，源自船底座古代船尾装饰。
45556.en: Aspidiske (Iota Carinae) is a white supergiant about 770 light-years away and a corner of the 'False Cross'. Its name means 'little shield', after the ornaments on the stern of the ancient ship Argo.

76267.zh: 贯索四是北冕座主星，距离约 75 光年，是一对白色星和类太阳黄矮星组成的食双星，约 17.4 天互绕一周。英文名意为“碗中最亮者”，北冕七星排成半圆，像一顶王冠。中国星官“贯索”指拘禁平民的牢狱。
76267.en: Alphecca, the leading star of Corona Borealis about 75 light-years away, is an eclipsing binary of a white star and a Sun-like yellow dwarf orbiting every ~17.4 days. Its name means 'the bright one of the dish', the crown's semicircle of stars. The Chinese asterism Guansuo is a prison for commoners.

44816.zh: 天纪是船帆座 λ，一颗距离约 545 光年的橙色超巨星，亮度有小幅不规则变化。英文名 Suhail 在阿拉伯传统中也常指老人星。
44816.en: Suhail (Lambda Velorum) is an orange supergiant about 545 light-years away with small irregular brightness variations. In Arabic tradition the name Suhail was also used for Canopus.

65378.zh: 开阳是北斗斗柄的中间星，距离约 83 光年。它是第一颗用望远镜发现的双星（17 世纪），其主星又是 1889 年发现的第一颗光谱双星；整个系统与旁边的辅星共有六颗成员。肉眼能否分辨开阳与辅，古代被当作视力测试。
65378.en: Mizar, the middle star of the Dipper's handle about 83 light-years away, was the first double star found with a telescope (17th century), and its primary was the first spectroscopic binary, discovered in 1889; with nearby Alcor the system has six stars. Seeing Mizar and Alcor apart was a traditional eyesight test.

100453.zh: 天津一是天鹅座 γ，位于“北十字”的中心，一颗距离约 1800 光年的黄白色超巨星。它周围是 IC 1318 发射星云，但星云其实远在它之后，并无关联。它坐落在银河最明亮的区域之一。
100453.en: Sadr (Gamma Cygni), at the centre of the Northern Cross, is a yellow-white supergiant about 1,800 light-years away. It appears among the IC 1318 emission nebula, which actually lies much farther behind. It sits in one of the richest parts of the Milky Way.

3179.zh: 王良四是仙后座 α，“W”形中的一颗，距离约 230 光年的橙巨星。中国星官“王良”是春秋时期善于驾车的人，五星排成战车与马。
3179.en: Schedar (Alpha Cassiopeiae), one of the stars of the 'W', is an orange giant about 230 light-years away. The Chinese asterism Wangliang is named after a legendary charioteer of the Spring and Autumn period.

87833.zh: 天棓四是天龙座最亮的星，距离约 154 光年的橙巨星，几乎经过伦敦天顶。1728 年布拉德雷在观测它时发现了光行差，为地球公转提供了直接证据。约 150 万年后它将飞近到约 28 光年，成为夜空最亮的恒星之一。
87833.en: Eltanin, the brightest star in Draco, is an orange giant about 154 light-years away that passes nearly overhead at London. Observing it in 1728, James Bradley discovered the aberration of light, direct evidence of Earth's orbital motion. In about 1.5 million years it will pass within about 28 light-years and shine among the brightest stars.

25930.zh: 参宿三是猎户腰带最西边的一颗，距离约 1200 光年，几乎正位于天赤道上，因此从地球各处看都是正东升、正西落。它是一个复杂的多星系统，主星是食双星。
25930.en: Mintaka, the westernmost Belt star about 1,200 light-years away, lies almost exactly on the celestial equator, so it rises due east and sets due west everywhere on Earth. It is a complex multiple system whose main pair is an eclipsing binary.

746.zh: 王良一是仙后座 β，距离约 55 光年，是一颗黄白色巨星，也是一颗 δ 盾牌型脉动变星。它几乎位于赤经 0 时线上，可以用来大致确定春分点所在的赤经圈。
746.en: Caph (Beta Cassiopeiae), about 55 light-years away, is a yellow-white giant and a Delta Scuti pulsating variable. It lies very close to the 0h right-ascension line, a handy marker of the equinox hour circle.

78401.zh: 房宿三是天蝎座 δ，位于蝎头，距离约 490 光年。它是一颗 Be 星，2000 年起突然增亮，从约 2.3 等一度亮到 1.6 等左右，改变了天蝎座的面貌。中国二十八宿中它属于房宿。
78401.en: Dschubba (Delta Scorpii) in the Scorpion's head is about 490 light-years away. A Be star, it began brightening suddenly in 2000, from about mag 2.3 to around 1.6, changing the look of Scorpius. In China it belongs to the Fang (Room) mansion.

82396.zh: 尾宿二是天蝎座 ε，距离约 64 光年的橙巨星。英文名 Larawag 来自澳大利亚原住民瓦达曼语，2017 年由国际天文学联合会批准。中国二十八宿中它属于尾宿。
82396.en: Epsilon Scorpii is an orange giant about 64 light-years away. Its name Larawag comes from the Wardaman language of Aboriginal Australia, approved by the IAU in 2017. In China it belongs to the Wei (Tail) mansion.

53910.zh: 天璇是北斗的第二星，距离约 80 光年，与天枢一起构成“指极星”。它是一颗白色亚巨星，周围有红外辐射显示的尘埃盘，属于大熊座移动星群。
53910.en: Merak, the second star of the Dipper about 80 light-years away, forms the 'Pointers' with Dubhe. It is a white subgiant with a debris disk revealed by infrared excess, and belongs to the Ursa Major Moving Group.

72105.zh: 梗河一是牧夫座 ε，距离约 200 光年，由橙色亮巨星和蓝白色伴星组成，色差优美，19 世纪斯特鲁维称之为“最美的星”（Pulcherrima）。两星相距仅约 3 角秒，需要较好的望远镜分辨。
72105.en: Izar (Epsilon Boötis), about 200 light-years away, pairs an orange bright giant with a blue-white companion in lovely contrast; Struve called it 'Pulcherrima', the most beautiful. The pair is only about 3 arcseconds apart and needs a good telescope.

107315.zh: 危宿三是飞马的鼻子，一颗距离约 690 光年的橙色超巨星，是飞马座最亮的星。1972 年曾观测到它短暂的耀发增亮。附近不远处是著名的球状星团 M15。
107315.en: Enif, the nose of Pegasus, is an orange supergiant about 690 light-years away and the constellation's brightest star. A brief flare was observed in 1972. The fine globular cluster M15 lies nearby.

2081.zh: 火鸟六是凤凰座主星，距离约 85 光年的橙巨星，英文名 Ankaa 意为“凤凰”。它是一颗光谱双星。凤凰座是 16 世纪末根据航海家的南天观测新设立的星座，在中国南方冬夜的南方低空可见。
2081.en: Ankaa, the leading star of Phoenix, is an orange giant about 85 light-years away; its name means 'phoenix'. It is a spectroscopic binary. Phoenix was introduced in the late 16th century from navigators' observations of the southern sky.

58001.zh: 天玑是北斗七星的第三星，位于斗勺底部，距离约 83 光年，是一颗白色主序星，属于大熊座移动星群。M109 星系就在它附近。
58001.en: Phecda, the third star of the Dipper at the bottom of the bowl, is a white main-sequence star about 83 light-years away and a member of the Ursa Major Moving Group. The galaxy M109 lies close by.

84012.zh: 宋是蛇夫座 η，距离约 88 光年，由两颗白色星组成双星，互绕周期约 88 年。中国星名“宋”是天市垣中代表诸侯国的星之一。
84012.en: Sabik (Eta Ophiuchi), about 88 light-years away, is a pair of white stars orbiting every ~88 years. Its Chinese name Song is one of the feudal states marked in the Heavenly Market enclosure.

113881.zh: 室宿二是飞马座 β，“飞马大四边形”的西北角，一颗距离约 196 光年的红巨星，亮度有半规则变化。中国二十八宿中它属于室宿。
113881.en: Scheat (Beta Pegasi), the northwest corner of the Great Square, is a red giant about 196 light-years away with semi-regular brightness changes. In China it belongs to the Shi (House) mansion.

35904.zh: 弧矢二是大犬座 η，大犬尾部的一颗蓝超巨星，距离较远且不确定，常引用约 2000 光年，光度可达太阳的十余万倍。中国星官中它是弧矢之弓的一部分。
35904.en: Aludra (Eta Canis Majoris), at the Great Dog's tail, is a blue supergiant whose distance is uncertain, often quoted around 2,000 light-years, with more than 100,000 times the Sun's luminosity. In Chinese astronomy it forms part of the bow Hushi.

105199.zh: 天钩五是仙王座主星，距离约 49 光年，是一颗快速自转的白色星，自转周期不到一天。由于岁差，约公元 7500 年前后它将成为北极星。中国星官“天钩”意为天上的钩子。
105199.en: Alderamin, the leading star of Cepheus about 49 light-years away, is a fast-rotating white star spinning in less than a day. Through precession it will become the pole star around AD 7500. The Chinese asterism Tiangou means the Heavenly Hook.

45941.zh: 天社五是船帆座 κ，距离约 570 光年的蓝白色星，与天社三、海石一、海石二组成“假十字”。“假十字”比南十字更大更暗，常让初到南半球的人认错。
45941.en: Markeb (Kappa Velorum), a blue-white star about 570 light-years away, completes the 'False Cross' with Delta Velorum, Avior and Aspidiske. The False Cross is larger and fainter than the Southern Cross and often fools newcomers to southern skies.

102488.zh: 天津九是天鹅座 ε，位于天鹅的翅膀，距离约 72 光年，是一颗正在核心燃烧氦的橙巨星（红团簇星）。英文名 Aljanah 意为“翅膀”。
102488.en: Aljanah (Epsilon Cygni) on the Swan's wing is an orange giant about 72 light-years away, burning helium in its core (a red-clump star). Its name means 'the wing'.

113963.zh: 室宿一是飞马座 α，“飞马大四边形”的西南角，距离约 133 光年的白色星。秋季夜空中的大四边形是寻找仙女座星系等天体的重要路标。中国二十八宿中它属于室宿（营室）。
113963.en: Markab (Alpha Pegasi), the southwest corner of the Great Square, is a white star about 133 light-years away. The Great Square is a key autumn signpost for finding objects such as the Andromeda Galaxy. In China it belongs to the Shi (House) mansion.

95947.zh: 辇道增七是天鹅的“嘴”，小望远镜下呈现金黄色与蓝色两颗星的绝美色差，是最受欢迎的双星之一。不过 Gaia 卫星数据显示两星的距离和自行并不一致，它们可能只是视线上的偶然重合，并非真正互绕。
95947.en: Albireo, the Swan's beak, shows a golden and a blue star in gorgeous contrast in a small telescope, one of the most popular doubles. However, Gaia data show the two have differing distances and motions, so they may be a chance alignment rather than a true orbiting pair.

65477.zh: 辅是开阳旁边的暗星，距离约 82 光年，与开阳相距约 12 角分，能否分辨两星是传统的视力测试。2009 年发现它自身也有一颗红矮星伴星。中国星名“辅”意为辅佐北斗的大臣。
65477.en: Alcor, the faint star beside Mizar about 82 light-years away, lies 12 arcminutes from it; splitting the two was a traditional eyesight test. In 2009 it was found to have its own red dwarf companion. Its Chinese name Fu means the minister who assists the Dipper.

68756.zh: 右枢是天龙座 α，距离约 300 光年。约公元前 2800 年前后它是北极星，与古埃及金字塔时代相当。中国星名“右枢”意为紫微垣右侧的门枢。它是一颗光谱双星。
68756.en: Thuban (Alpha Draconis), about 300 light-years away, was the pole star around 2800 BC, the era of Egypt's pyramid builders. Its Chinese name Youshu means the right pivot of the Purple Forbidden enclosure's gate. It is a spectroscopic binary.

17702.zh: 昴宿六是昴星团最亮的星，距离约 440 光年，是一颗蓝白色巨星，也是 Be 星。昴星团在中国是二十八宿的昴宿，西方称七姐妹，是全天最著名的疏散星团，肉眼可见六七颗星。
17702.en: Alcyone, the brightest star of the Pleiades about 440 light-years away, is a blue-white giant and a Be star. The Pleiades, the Mao mansion in China and the Seven Sisters in the West, is the most famous open cluster, with six or seven stars visible to the eye.

59774.zh: 天权是北斗七星中最暗的一颗，连接斗勺与斗柄，距离约 80 光年，是一颗白色主序星，属于大熊座移动星群。大熊座移动星群是离太阳最近的星群之一，北斗中除天枢和摇光外的五颗星都是成员。
59774.en: Megrez, the faintest star of the Big Dipper, joins the bowl to the handle. It is a white main-sequence star about 80 light-years away and a member of the Ursa Major Moving Group, one of the nearest stellar groups, which includes five of the seven Dipper stars.
